o.text:
From Proto-Turkic *ōyna-. Cognate with
Turkish oynamak,
Turkmen oýnamak,
Crimean Tatar oynamaq,
etc.
From tala + -n. Cognate with Ottoman Turkish تالان (talan), Chagatai [script needed] (talay, talan).
From Proto-Turkic *yabĺan (“wormwood”). Cognate with Turkish yavşan, Turkmen ýowşan, Tuvan чашпан (çaşpan), Kazakh жусан (juwsan).
